not_benchmarked.reason: Declared with a severity and seven-language text, but no addFinding call site raises it; the verified-without-evidence condition it names is already raised by R066 (no actual evidence) and R071 (no planned evidence).

manifest.note: Manifest v2, tools.petrov.re namespace, project-delivery category; benchmark run_at equals the artifact run_at and the declared case counts equal the artifact totals.

localisation.note: 275 tool label objects carry all seven languages with no empty value and no Cyrillic text in an en slot; the review queue, the coverage table and the report body now render in the language the page was opened with.

mobile_desktop.note: Rendered at 1440x900 and 390x844: document scrollWidth equals clientWidth at both widths, no root horizontal overflow.

permalink_round_trip.note: Encode-decode-expand reproduced the working set exactly at 0, 1, 20, 100, 200 and 400 requirements.

permalink_size.note: The encoded state passes the 4 kB framework guidance at about 65 requirements: 5987 characters at 100 requirements and 11603 at 200. The JSON record is the portable format above that.

presets.note: Five examples load through the public DiagramUI example API: three traced baselines and two deliberate problem cases; every one produced a verdict, four tiles and both result tables with no console error.

learn_mode.note: Intro and three topics are declared through DiagramUI and render.

stale_recompute.note: Live-compute tool; every state change re-evaluates the rule set before the results panel repaints.

csv_tsv_import.note: JSON, CSV and TSV import paths accepted; a JSON record exported by this build re-imports through report_context.baseline.

report_all_languages.note: Diagram.report({mode:html}) built in all seven languages: 8 sections and one figure in each, with no sentence longer than 45 characters printed twice.

report_pagination.note: Report uses framework pagination; the tool declares no print layout of its own.

report_figure.note: The traceability graph is supplied through ctx.figure at 1520x680 with a localized caption and the stage text alternative, so the printed figure no longer follows the reader window width.

invalid_tokens.note: Report text and the CSV record export carry zero undefined, NaN, [object Object] and unfilled brace placeholders.

report_repetition.note: No sentence longer than 45 characters is printed twice in the report in any of the seven languages.

scale.note: The two pair rules R038 and R039 are quadratic in the requirement count. Memoising the token sets and the threshold parse leaves every finding identical and takes one evaluation from 518.7 ms to 19.7 ms at 200 requirements and from 2054.1 ms to 79.5 ms at 400. The declared editor limit stays 200 requirements and 500 verification activities.

queue_truncation.note: The review queue prints at most 80 grouped rows and now declares shown and total, so a larger finding set is visible as truncated.

benchmark_regeneration_parity.note: window.__dgcBenchmark() deep-equals the shipped artifact after JSON serialization normalization.

benchmark_coverage.note: The 68 cases assert all 69 rule identifiers that addFinding can raise, each in both directions: 69 of 69 asserted present in at least one case and absent in at least one other. The two remaining declared identifiers, R026 and R031, have no code path and are recorded in not_benchmarked.

dead_rules.note: R026 and R031 carry a severity and seven-language text but no code path raises them; R031 contradicts the one-to-many verification model this build implements. They are recorded here and in the artifact not_benchmarked array rather than removed.

console.note: Zero page errors and zero console errors over boot, five example loads, seven report builds, both viewports and the 400-requirement load case.
